idea-plugin.name: Sailfish OS SDK Integration
idea-plugin.description:
Develop Sailfish OS applications in CLion with the Sailfish SDK's sfdk tool.

  • New Project wizard: Sailfish OS Application, created with sfdk init for a chosen build target and registered device.
  • Debug builds, release builds and clean run through sfdk and report to CLion's Build tool window, as a custom build target with a native Sailfish SDK step type.
  • Deploy to the device as a before-launch step, using sfdk deploy --rsync.
  • Debug on the device with CLion's Remote GDB Server configuration, created and wired up by the wizard.
  • Code insight from the project's compilation database, rewritten against the SDK's target sysroot.

Requires the Sailfish SDK (sfdk in ~/SailfishOS/bin, or set in the wizard or under Settings | Build, Execution, Deployment | Sailfish OS SDK), a device registered with the SDK, a CLion SSH configuration for that device, and clang and clang++ on the host for indexing.

Source and issues: github.com/Lokomojo/sailfishos-clion-plugin
